art_direction: 浅长春花底，双眼同时轻睁，抬起目光，带着意外的好奇。
composition_variation: Keep the eye centers nearly level and widen both openings evenly, left lower contour rounder. Lift thick lids in gentle arches and aim large pupils forward and a little up. Keep pupils broad, not tiny pinpricks, with matching iris at sides and below. Convey pleasant composed surprise. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
